name: docs-warden
description: Keeps repository documentation consistent and honest. Scaffolds a document set scaled by repo archetype, audits for missing, stale or off-standard docs, and regenerates generated docs so drift from the code is reported, not discovered. Ships a plain-English Vale style, a domain-model skill, and optional compliance overlays (IEC 62304, OSPS Baseline, EU CRA, NIST SSDF) that describe document structure only and never invent regulatory content.
